summary: Two US federal systems report break-ins this week: the USDA farm payment system and, per news reports, the FBI crime database. No official source links them or names an attacker. Stocks and Bitcoin fell hard on AI worries. I found no trading halts or exchange outages.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC to check warrants and records. Nobody has said whether it was down or whether data was taken or changed.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI has not commented publicly. CNN and NBC cite two unnamed people briefed on the case. BleepingComputer sees no sign of a link to the earlier FBI breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident disrupts farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm payment, loan and conservation tools were offline for days. A USDA official said most systems should be back Friday or over the weekend. No personal data was lost, he said.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat. Staff reset database passwords. Reports say hackers got in. Nobody has named who did it.

events.title: US stocks fall sharply; Dow and S&P 500 in correction
events.impact: Friday close: Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.28%), S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.93%). Prices match across CNBC, NPR and Yahoo. Markets are closed Saturday. I found no reports of trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite worry about AI spending, with Nvidia down 14%. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported.

events.title: Bitcoin trades near 56K to 60K USD, down about 12 to 15% on the week
events.impact: Price pages disagree because of timing: CoinGecko 60,498 (24h range 55,298 to 62,087), CoinDesk 58,683 on Nov 20, eToro and Kraken near 58,050. Coinbase and Binance quotes matched on CoinDesk. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. The drop moves with the stock selloff.

events.title: Iran and US trade strikes around Bahrain, Kuwait and Hormuz
events.impact: Iran hit sites in Bahrain and a Kuwait air base. The US struck Qeshm Island. New: Iran claimed it hit a US F-16 Friday, and CENTCOM denied it. Tanker traffic is still at risk.
events.stated_cause: Iran says it is answering US drone flights and strikes on its towers. The US calls its strikes defensive. Talks are deadlocked.

events.title: Officials say earlier US outages were not cyber attacks
events.impact: Trump administration officials, including the Homeland Security Secretary, have repeatedly said last week's outages were not a cyber attack. Some experts and reporters still question the timing.
events.stated_cause: Officials gave separate ordinary causes for the Microsoft, FAA and NSA problems. No official source reports a cyber attack on those.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. Federal agencies must fix them. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA says it has evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker.

events.title: Undersea cable fault slows internet in Pakistan
events.impact: Pakistan's telecom authority reported a SEA-ME-WE 5 fault offshore with slow service. I found no new update in this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown and under investigation. Sabotage claims on social media are unverified.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: The status feed lists Cloudflare Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 07:44 UTC Nov 21. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: USDA calls its problem a cyberthreat and reset passwords; the FBI has said nothing, and nobody has named an attacker for either. The stock and Bitcoin drops are blamed on AI worries. No official source links these events to each other.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the USDA and FBI breaches, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No new escalation since the last run. The FBI and USDA items were already reported, and no official link has appeared.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. Check that your farm or government benefit payments post on time over the next week. Watch for scam emails that mention the USDA or FBI breaches. Keep some cash on hand and avoid panic selling during market swings.
